WITH rating_prices AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
average_price AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS across_rating_avg
  FROM rating_prices
)
SELECT AVG(rp.avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price,
       AVG(rp.avg_daily_price - ap.across_rating_avg) AS avg_above_across_rating_avg
FROM rating_prices rp
CROSS JOIN average_price ap
WHERE rp.avg_daily_price > ap.across_rating_avg;
